cause_quote: The refactor added `import { MAX_PAYLOAD_BYTES } from "../../gateway/server-constants.js";` to `session-pending-input-value.ts`, making modules that used the shared pending-input helpers pull in a forbidden Gateway server dependency.
summary: The fix moved the unchanged 25 MiB payload limit into a shared module outside the Gateway server graph and redirected its consumers.
reasoning: The earlier worker-isolation fix recorded that all nine standalone entries passed the build-graph check, and #169124's parent still had the same rule excluding Gateway server modules. The #169124 diff added the forbidden import in the shared pending-input helper and wired existing session modules to it, matching the fix message's report that the state-read and read-only SQLite worker checks began failing after that merge.
